verdict.rationale: Obsidian's first-party Templates core plugin lets you insert pre-defined text snippets into a note (obsidian-docs-5). Templates can contain dynamic template variables (obsidian-docs-44), which covers the core of reusable, variable-driven templates. The Daily notes plugin also creates date-based recurring notes (obsidian-docs-4), though the evidence never says it applies a template. missing for 10: explicit documentation that date and title are among the variables, evidence that templates apply automatically at note creation rather than by insertion into an already-open note, independent or hands-on corroboration.
